purpose: Browse a conversation history in a scrolling region.
avoid: New messages must not unexpectedly displace a reader of older content.
basis: Native source page 2360:5132 (Message Scroller), observed anatomy and examples.
openDecisions: Scroll anchoring, unread position, virtualization, update announcements and history loading.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
